title: Program red-team report
description: What Mynt's program red team writes to job/report.json. The mainnet program gate validates the report against this file, and the red team's own check (scripts/check_report.py in its workspace) validates against the same file, handed to it as job/report.schema.json. A report that doesn't validate, or that says it is incomplete, never lets a program pass.

complete.description: false while the work is unfinished, or when the program couldn't be attacked at all (then incomplete_reason says why). Leave it out, or set it true, only when every attack you meant to try has been run.

incomplete_reason.description: Required when complete is false: what stopped the work (for example the toolchain's install failed, with the last line of its log).

findings.description: One entry per weakness found. Empty when nothing exploitable was found.

vulnerability.description: The vulnerability database entry's id, when the finding belongs to one.

description.description: What an attacker does and what they gain.

poc.description: The proof of concept's folder name under job/poc (the folder holds run.sh). Null or absent for a finding that couldn't be proved.

attacks_tried.description: Each attack tried and what happened, one line each.
